title: Shift in Perspective
description: Resourcepack that rotates "JAVA EDITION" text so it "sticks" to the MINECRAFT text above it.
body:
### A simple resourcepack that rotates "JAVA EDITION" text.
Literally. All this resourcepack does is just rotates java edition text under the main logo so it looks like these bedrock update logos.
